dict.string: MyFluidVoice needs Accessibility permission to listen for global hotkeys and type text into other apps when you stop recording.
MyFluidVoice needs microphone access to transcribe your voice. On-device models process audio locally; if you choose Apple Speech, macOS may use Apple's speech service.
MyFluidVoice needs permission to control system events for managing launch at startup settings.
MyFluidVoice uses Apple's speech recognition when you select an Apple Speech model; macOS may process that audio using Apple's speech service.
